title: TemporalGroundingProfile
description: Declares how an implementation resolves external evidence units to controlled source states and determines temporal admissibility. Conceptually B_ρ = ⟨U_ρ, S_ρ, owner_ρ, admissible_ρ⟩, matching spec/05 (ρ is the grounding profile; π is the admission policy). A conforming profile MUST provide two behavioral functions: owner_ρ(evidenceUnitId) -> SourceStateRef, and admissible_ρ(sourceStateId, queryTime, observerTime?) -> admissibility result. PROFILE AUTHORITY: the profile DEFINES what temporal admissibility means; the TIER-Graph core MUST NOT override it. This schema describes the profile's DECLARED metadata and capabilities; the functions themselves are exposed through the API's grounding operations.

id.description: Opaque, unique identifier for this profile.

evidenceUnitType.description: The kind of evidence unit this profile controls (e.g. 'document-fragment', 'clinical-note', 'record-entry').

sourceStateType.description: The kind of source state that owns evidence units (e.g. 'document-version', 'record-revision').

admissibilitySemantics.description: A precise statement of what 'admissible at time t' means for this profile (e.g. 't within the version's applicability interval'). This is the authoritative definition the core defers to.

description.description: Optional prose description of the profile.

supportedSelectors.description: Evidence-selector types supported by this profile.

vocabularyRef.description: The ProfileVocabulary version this grounding profile is deployed with. Semantic vocabulary and temporal authority are orthogonal concerns declared in separate documents and versioned independently; this field records which pair a deployment binds, so that profile-scoped introspection and identity reproduction can resolve it. Optional only because a grounding profile MAY be published on its own; a deployment that serves identity comparison, predicates, or predicate-family filters MUST declare it.

defaultAdmissionPolicyId.description: Optional default AdmissionPolicy applied when the caller does not specify one.
